title: fix(desktop): never lose a finished recording when the vault is unreachable (audit REC-B6, REC-A8)
body:
## What was broken

- **REC-B6:** `RecordingWriter.finalize` closed and deleted the session before it created the vault folder and moved the file. If the vault was unreachable (unplugged drive, unwritable folder) or a cross-volume copy failed, the finished take stayed as an invisible `kaipu-rec-*.mp4.part` in `os.tmpdir()`. The renderer showed a generic "couldn't save", then `recordingAbort` was a no-op. Nothing ever recovered the file, and a failed copy could leave a partial `<id>.mp4` in the vault.
- **REC-A8:** the `.part` always lived in `os.tmpdir()`, so a vault on another volume paid a full-file copy during "Saving..." and the system disk had to hold the whole take.

## What changed

- The `.part` is now staged in `<vault>/.kaipu/tmp/` (falls back to `os.tmpdir()` if that cannot be created), so the final move is a same-volume rename. An explicit `tempDir` dep still wins (tests).
- `finalize` resolves and creates the destination before closing the session. A failed move throws `FinalizeMoveError` and marks the session stranded. `abort` leaves a stranded `.part` on disk. A failed copy removes only the half-written destination (`moveFile`, with `COPYFILE_EXCL`).
- On `FinalizeMoveError` the hub opens a native save dialog from main and `writer.salvage` moves the take there. The rejection carries `[finalize:kept]` or `[finalize:elsewhere]`, and the renderer maps it to a specific toast (new `record.errorSaveKept` / `record.errorSaveElsewhere` / `dialogs.saveRecordingElsewhere` keys in en and es).
- New launch sweep (`stranded-recordings.ts`, wired in `main/index.ts` before `createWindow()`): moves `kaipu-rec-*.mp4.part` files older than 2 minutes from the vault staging folder and tmp into the vault as "Recovered recording"; empty parts are deleted.

Trade-off: a vault inside iCloud/Dropbox now syncs the growing `.part` (the finding proposed this).

## Verification (from `apps/kaipu-record`)

- `bun run test`: 255 files, 2217 tests passed (includes new writer, move-failure, hub, sweep and `finalizeErrorKey` tests).
- `bun run check-types`: node and web projects clean.
- `bun run lint`: 0 errors (17 pre-existing warnings).
- `packages/i18n`: `bun run test` 22 passed, `bun run check-types` clean.
- Not verified: the parentless save dialog showing in front on macOS while the main window is hidden (manual).

## How to test it yourself

1. Settings > Files: set the vault to a USB volume or mounted disk image. Record 5 s. While recording, `ls "<vault>/.kaipu/tmp"` shows `kaipu-rec-session-1.mp4.part`. Stop: the file lands in the vault instantly.
2. Record again and eject the volume just before Stop. Expect the native "choose where to save" dialog. Pick a path: the toast says it was saved where you chose and the file plays.
3. Repeat but cancel the dialog: the toast says the recording was kept. Re-mount, relaunch: the Library shows "Recovered recording".
4. Confirm the dialog appears in front although the main window was hidden (macOS).

## Findings closed

REC-B6, REC-A8. The plan lives in PR #301 (`docs/code-audit-2026-10-15`, `plans/audit-2026-10-15/02-recording-finalize-recovery.md`).
